title: Can You Rent a Jet Ski in Madeira?
description: Yes, from Funchal and Calheta. Without a licence you ride in a marked area or a closed circuit. The open coast needs at least a Marinheiro boat licence.
heroAlt: A jet ski with two riders carving a white wake across the bay of Funchal
keywords: can you rent a jet ski in Madeira
jet ski or boat trip Madeira
